B0: abs(start_change_pct), as recorded for the displayed board
B1: stored live_score for up; 100-live_score for down
B2: ridge on the three model_raw_inputs, with price returns direction-aligned
M1: B2 plus squared 1m/3m returns and interactions (1m*3m, 1m*volume, 3m*volume)
optional_input_rule: pct_1h and trend_streak are profiled but excluded from the primary model. Any complete-case secondary comparison must rerun every baseline on exactly that same subset. No imputation of observed market values.
preprocess: Fit 1st/99th percentile winsor limits and standardization on fitting rows only; no full-sample normalization. Compute the listed transforms from clipped raw inputs then standardize each resulting column.
selection: Fit candidates on train only; choose alpha separately for B2/M1 by discovery mean daily Spearman IC; ties choose larger alpha. Refit selected models and transforms on train+discovery excluding purged rows; keep fixed throughout test.
primary_statistic: Mean across UTC days of paired within-day Spearman IC(M1)-IC(B2), within the primary stratum. Use identical complete-label episodes for every model; daily groups require >=20 rows and nonconstant target and predictions for all compared models.
uncertainty: 95% bootstrap over paired daily differences, 5000 replicates, seed 20261027; sensitivity: moving blocks of 3 consecutive UTC calendar days, 5000 replicates. Missing days remain missing, not zero; do not bridge calendar gaps.
historically_supportive: Primary difference >=0.02, lower bound >0 in both intervals, positive discovery difference. Otherwise inconclusive or below the minimum effect; this is a historical pilot, not untouched evidence or permission to change live weights.
display_score: 0-100 percentile of prediction against the fixed train+discovery prediction distribution; ordinal, direction- and horizon-labelled, not a probability. Evaluate raw prediction IC and report any score saturation.
cost_reporting: Report gross and gross-minus-cost scenarios separately using CONTRACT_PRODUCTION costs. Never subtract costs again from stored return_5m/return_15m. No historical spread/fill reconstruction.
reporting: Daily coverage and sample counts, each stratum separately, B0/B1/B2/M1 ICs, paired differences, gross/scenario returns by score quintile, missingness and sensitivity attrition. No pooled up/down success claim.
required_before_test: Committed driver/config/input hashes and a matching discovery artifact; test refuses changed inputs and an existing test artifact. No fundamentals inputs.
live_release: Not part of this study. Fresh prospective shadow confirmation after a model freeze is required before any ranking/weight release.
